probe.conditioning: one frozen split and fitted probe per method; fitting uncertainty excluded
probe.r2_denominator: target variance recomputed in each resampled evaluation set
probe.classifier_exception: Aggregate scores and a median certificate are available; per-value predictions are absent, so no classifier interval is estimated.

steering.unit: baseline_row_idx, identifying one source context and value
steering.conditioning: frozen model, policies, and twenty targets per source; policy-fitting uncertainty excluded
steering.zero_successes: Display the observed count. Percentile resampling of all-zero observations cannot estimate an upper success bound; interval endpoints are unavailable.
steering.constant_paired_change: An interval is omitted when all resampled paired changes are identical.

existing_deletion_intervals.control_seed_reduction: mean within each split/task/value before bootstrap
existing_deletion_intervals.interpretation: conditional on the ten frozen fitted bases; no training-set uncertainty

contradiction_counts.conditioning: fixed baseline-correct sets of 100 classification queries and fifty enumeration prompts
contradiction_counts.intervals: Counts are descriptive; a sampling design for population intervals is unavailable.
